description: Download a file from a public https link (50 MB max) and save it inside the matter's Dropbox folder. Never overwrites. Preview first; apply with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: Must be omitted or false on the first call — that only previews. Never invent a preview_id. After the person agrees, call again with confirm: true AND the preview_id this server returned.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

path.description: Destination file, relative to the matter folder, including the file name.

preview_id.description: Exactly the preview_id this server returned on a prior call for these arguments. Required with confirm: true. Never generate or reuse one from another tool or conversation.

source_url.description: Public https:// link to download the file from. 50 MB max.

name: upload_dropbox_file
title: Upload file to Dropbox
